contentList.content: Set the maximum number of automatic ULTRA reinforcement waves active in the same combat: 1–5 or Unlimited (default). A wave is one spawned batch, not a number of bosses. It remains active while at least one of its members is alive and in that combat. This does not limit the total number of successive waves in a combat.

ULTRA Concurrent Wave Limit: 1

Yes selects this limit. No shows the next option.

ULTRA Concurrent Wave Limit: 2

Yes selects this limit. No shows the next option.

ULTRA Concurrent Wave Limit: 3

Yes selects this limit. No shows the next option.

ULTRA Concurrent Wave Limit: 4

Yes selects this limit. No shows the next option.

ULTRA Concurrent Wave Limit: 5

Yes selects this limit. No shows the next option.

ULTRA Concurrent Wave Limit: Unlimited

Yes selects Unlimited. No returns to 1.
